test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In relation to Production Possibilities Curve (PPC), which of the following statements is INCORRECT?

options.text: If the PPC curve is not a straight line, the opportunity cost is constant.
The PPC is also called production possibility boundary.
Shift of the PPC curve is nothing but economic growth.
Any point that lies below the PPC curve is a possible combination. But if the economy is working below the PPC curve that indicates the unused resources or unemployment.

solution:
The correct answer is** If the PPC curve is not a straight line, the opportunity cost is constant.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **If the PPC curve is not a straight line, the opportunity cost is constant:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. If the PPC curve is not a straight line, it implies that the opportunity cost is not constant. Instead, it varies depending on the combination of goods being produced. A bowed-outward (concave) PPC indicates increasing opportunity costs, meaning more of one good must be given up to produce additional units of the other good.
 
• In a financial enterprise context, this concept is crucial for making decisions about resource allocation. For example, if a company allocates resources to different projects, the increasing opportunity cost means that reallocating resources to one project will result in a progressively larger sacrifice in the output of another project.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The PPC is also called production possibility boundary:**

 
 
• This statement is correct. The PPC (Production Possibilities Curve) is also known as the production possibility boundary or frontier. It represents the maximum possible output combinations of two goods that an economy can achieve, given available resources and technology.
 
 
 
• **Shift of the PPC curve is nothing but economic growth:**
 
 
• Correct. When the PPC curve shifts outward, it indicates economic growth. This shift can be due to factors such as an increase in resources, technological advancements, or improvements in the efficiency of resource utilization.
 
• In a financial enterprise, economic growth could mean increased investment opportunities, expansion of markets, and higher potential returns on investments.
 
 
 
• **Any point that lies below the PPC curve is a possible combination. But if the economy is working below the PPC curve that indicates the unused resources or unemployment:**
 
 
• This statement is accurate. Points below the PPC indicate that the economy is not utilizing all its resources efficiently, leading to underemployment or unemployment. It suggests that the economy can produce more of both goods without sacrificing the production of either.
 
• For a financial enterprise, operating below the PPC might mean that the company is not utilizing its assets and resources to their fullest potential, indicating inefficiency.
